use: Grabbed a good vegetable: soil scrape, cork-pop, upward 'bwip!'
Grabbed a rotten vegetable: wet squelch + deflated 'bwuhh'
Each successful tug: crisp sheet snap + tiny 'hup' (short, mash-friendly)
Opponent yanks you / you lose ground: whoosh, slap-thud, drooping boing
Wheel lands on a high number: wooden clack + bright ting
Wheel lands on a low number: dull clonk + wobbly 'bwoing'
Correct button / order served: water 'bloop' + glass tink
Wrong button: tin cup clatters, water spills, droopy 'bwuh'
